name: template-registry
body: Template registry / schema engine: schema model (fields, types, formats, body rules, sections) populated from project `template.yaml` manifests by the template-library-loader, with each template's kind taken from its directory (slides/ or sections/). Load-time checks (cycles rejected with the chain in the error — a reference is a declared `sections:` acceptance or a `section` helper call in a layout, section-helper-load-checks —, composition depth no greater than six heading levels, directory-kind check for section acceptance and field types, cross-kind name uniqueness, reserved names — `notes`, `body`, the `_format` suffix and the reserved context names `deck`/`slide`/`item`/`raw`/`data` —, references, and recursive example validation), including the static `section` helper checks (the target exists and is section-usage, literal `dict` keys are declared fields, required fields present or defaulted, a target declaring a min>0 child section is rejected), lookup and description. Owns the central, documented layout function map (`media "path"` → served URL of the file at the resolved library's `media/<path>`; the path is relative to the resolved library's `media/` and stays within it; a theme's files are addressed from its theme directory, by a relative path or the reserved `theme:<name>/` prefix, never through `media`; plus the `section`, `dict` and `list` helpers — template-language, section-helper, dict-list-helpers). Templates come solely from the resolved library (global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets).
